_budgets: maxOutputTokens includes a reasoning model's thinking: Gemini 4 and GPT-6 think before they answer, and an 8,000 budget came back empty on a 25-claim chapter (2026-11-14). Only tokens used are billed.
_comment: Phase ED: the mchatai.com education services (web-api /v1/learn/*). Roles name a model from llm-catalog/providers/<provider>.json, called through compute-proxy and billed to the signed-in user's compute tokens. Edit here to change a model, a limit or a prompt with no redeploy; web-api reloads this every 5 minutes. The checker must be a different provider family from the writer, so one model never grades its own questions (tools/check_services.py enforces it).
_parked: 2026-11-14: the Anthropic roles (Opus 5.5 writer and essay grader, Sonnet 5.5 answer grader, Gemini 3.8 Flash checker) wait until compute-proxy's Anthropic key has credit (it answers "credit balance is too low"). Flip them back here; no redeploy.

review._comment: Leitner boxes: a right answer moves the item up one box, a wrong one sends it to box 1. Days until the item is due again, per box.
